source: captured against the fake model (2026-11-10), by backend/runner/src/e2e/shells.e2e.ts's script; ids and paths replaced. The transcript lines and TaskStop's result are the real run's; the hook payloads take the shapes of waiting.probe.json's (Bash's PostToolUse, Stop's background_tasks, a notification as a prompt) with the real run's ids and commands
how: The agent starts three Bash commands with run_in_background in one turn (a loop A that exits 3, a loop C that exits 0, and a loop B that never ends), ends its turn, and later stops B with TaskStop. Each Bash's PostToolUse carries backgroundTaskId; the Stop lists the three as shell tasks; when C and A end Claude Code queues a <task-notification> (`queue-operation` enqueue in the transcript) and starts a turn with it (UserPromptSubmit); the summary says `completed (exit code 0)` or `failed with exit code 3`. TaskStop's result names the task it stopped and writes no notification. `ids` are the three task ids in start order.

commands: i=0; while [ $i -lt 6 ]; do echo "tick $i"; i=$((i+1)); sleep 2; done; exit 3
i=0; while [ $i -lt 3 ]; do echo "tick $i"; i=$((i+1)); sleep 2; done; exit 0
while true; do echo "up $(date +%s)"; sleep 2; done
